title: .plinth-adoption.yml
description: A repository's adoption record (#1112): written by the adopt pull request, read by scripts/floor-check.py, which also checks what a schema cannot (a kept id is registered and keepable, an until has not passed, started is not after today, wall_due is read as at most 30 days after started). `floor-check.py --print-adoption` prints the file in this shape; tests/floor-check-cases.sh validates every record its cases write against this file, and holds the checker's verdict on each to the schema's.

plinth.description: The plinth release that wrote the file.

origin.description: none, or other-template:<_src_path> when another template made the repository.

step.description: Where the adoption is: the files, the ci call, the wall, or done.

wall_due.description: Until this date, and only while the default branch has no rules, the wall prints as later and is not counted. Read as at most 30 days after started.

id.description: The check's id in scripts/floor-check.py's REGISTRY; one marked not keepable is not applied.
